verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers Drive's developer API (uploads, permissions, push notifications, properties) and one item about building a custom AI agent add-on via ADK/Vertex AI Agent Engine—none of which describes a built-in assistant inside the Drive product that an end user can delegate tasks to (e.g., no mention of Gemini in Drive or an in-product assistant UI). Missing for 10: any documentation of a first-party built-in AI assistant, evidence of end-user task delegation within the Drive interface, and community/hands-on confirmation of such a feature.
